Callout.Name: Trailer Park Dispute
Callout.Message: Long-running dispute between neighbours on a trailer park.
Callout.Advisory: Shouting in the street, no weapons reported.

Script.Line: It is a fence. It has been a fence for nine years.
He moved the posts. Ask anybody on this row, he moved the posts.
I am not shouting. I am explaining.

Lines.Approach: Third time this month and it is the same two arguing about the same fence.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
